title: Dasara elephants arrive at Mysore Palace for Jamboo Savari rehearsals
snippet: The first batch of nine elephants led by Abhimanyu were welcomed at the Jayamarthanda Gate.

title: Palace illumination timings extended for Dasara fortnight
snippet: The palace will be illuminated from 7 pm to 10 pm every day during Dasara.

title: Yaduveer Wadiyar to hold private durbar at palace during Navaratri
snippet: The golden throne will be assembled in the Durbar Hall.

title: Court adjourns hearing in palace land case
Two held for chain snatching in Vijayanagar
snippet: Police arrested two youths for allegedly snatching gold chains.

title: ಮೈಸೂರು ಅರಮನೆಗೆ ದಸರಾ ಆನೆಗಳ ಆಗಮನ
snippet: ಅಭಿಮನ್ಯು ನೇತೃತ್ವದ ಒಂಬತ್ತು ಆನೆಗಳು ಅರಮನೆಗೆ ಆಗಮಿಸಿದವು.
